metadata.title: Groupicorn Minnesota IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. This Twin Cities Metro update adds current official site evidence for mental-health and substance-use IOP/PHP programs; remaining leads stay in the verification queue until exact-site evidence is checked. This is not a statewide re-verification.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a tracked PNG asset acquired from an official provider-controlled source. License clearance is not implied.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored where sourced; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.
